scope: Direct pure native functions on own two canaries only; no global MANIFEST mutation or whole-loop acceptance

fence.statement: theorem variable_quadratic_actual_run : let V : Set ℝ := Icc 0 2 let loss : ℕ → ℝ → EReal := fun _ z => if z ∈ V then ((z ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤ let η : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => if t = 0 then 1 else 1 / 2 let x : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => if t = 0 then 2 else if t = 1 then 1 else 2 / 3 Convex ℝ V ∧ V.Nonempty ∧ IsClosed V ∧ (∀ t, SourceProper (loss t) ∧ IsConvexExtended (loss t) ∧ effectiveDomain (loss t) = V) ∧ (∀ t, ∀ z ∈ V, z ∈ SourceSubdifferential (loss t) z) ∧ loss 0 3 = ⊤ ∧ (loss 0 0).toReal + (loss 0 2).toReal ≠ 2 * (loss 0 1).toReal ∧ (∀ t, 0 < η t) ∧ (∀ t, η (t + 1) ≤ η t) ∧ η 0 = 1 ∧ η 1 = 1 / 2 ∧ x 0 = 2 ∧ x 1 = 1 ∧ x 2 = 2 / 3 ∧ (∀ t < 2, x (t + 1) ∈ V ∧ IsMinOn (fun z => loss t z + ((‖z - x t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η t) : ℝ) : EReal)) V (x (t + 1))) ∧ (∀ t ≤ 2, iterate V (fun z : ℝ => ‖z‖ ^ 2 / 2) η loss 2 t = some (x t)) ∧ (∑ t ∈ range 2, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t 0).toReal)) = 13 / 18 ∧ (∑ t ∈ range 2, ((loss t (x t)).toReal - (loss t 0).toReal)) = 5 / 2 ∧ ‖x 1 - x 0‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η 0) = 1 / 2 ∧ ‖x 2 - x 1‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η 1) = 1 / 9 ∧ (∑ t ∈ range 2, ‖x (t + 1) - x t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η t)) = 11 / 18 ∧ (∀ u ∈ V, (∑ t ∈ range 2, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤ ((range 2).sup' (nonempty_range_iff.mpr (by decide : (2 : ℕ) ≠ 0)) (fun t => ‖u - x t‖ ^ 2 / 2)) / η 1 - ∑ t ∈ range 2, ‖x (t + 1) - x t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η t)) ∧ (13 / 18 : ℝ) ≤ 61 / 18

theorem fixed_quadratic_actual_run : let V : Set ℝ := Icc 0 2 let loss : ℕ → ℝ → EReal := fun _ z => if z ∈ V then ((z ^ 2 / 2 : ℝ) : EReal) else ⊤ let η : ℕ → ℝ := fun _ => 1 let x : ℕ → ℝ := fun t => if t = 0 then 2 else if t = 1 then 1 else 1 / 2 Convex ℝ V ∧ V.Nonempty ∧ IsClosed V ∧ (∀ t, SourceProper (loss t) ∧ IsConvexExtended (loss t) ∧ effectiveDomain (loss t) = V) ∧ (∀ t, ∀ z ∈ V, z ∈ SourceSubdifferential (loss t) z) ∧ loss 0 3 = ⊤ ∧ (loss 0 0).toReal + (loss 0 2).toReal ≠ 2 * (loss 0 1).toReal ∧ (∀ t, 0 < η t) ∧ (∀ t, η (t + 1) ≤ η t) ∧ η 0 = 1 ∧ η 1 = 1 ∧ x 0 = 2 ∧ x 1 = 1 ∧ x 2 = 1 / 2 ∧ (∀ t < 2, x (t + 1) ∈ V ∧ IsMinOn (fun z => loss t z + ((‖z - x t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η t) : ℝ) : EReal)) V (x (t + 1))) ∧ (∀ t ≤ 2, iterate V (fun z : ℝ => ‖z‖ ^ 2 / 2) η loss 2 t = some (x t)) ∧ (∑ t ∈ range 2, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t 0).toReal)) = 5 / 8 ∧ (∑ t ∈ range 2, ((loss t (x t)).toReal - (loss t 0).toReal)) = 5 / 2 ∧ ‖x 1 - x 0‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η 0) = 1 / 2 ∧ ‖x 2 - x 1‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η 1) = 1 / 8 ∧ (∑ t ∈ range 2, ‖x (t + 1) - x t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η t)) = 5 / 8 ∧ (∀ u ∈ V, (∑ t ∈ range 2, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤ ‖u - (2 : ℝ)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * 1) - (∑ t ∈ range 2, ‖x (t + 1) - x t‖ ^ 2) / (2 * 1)) ∧ (5 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ 11 / 8
